This script analyzes RNAseq (transcriptomics) data. It's my first time doing this lol

----------------------------
HOW TO USE THIS SCRIPT
Always run Sections 1. Packages, 2. Functions, 3. Data
Sections 4. Differential Expression and 5. Functional Analyses should run independently of each other.

---------------------------

To write section 4 of this script, I heavily depended on AI. Section 5.1. is based off this v helpful github post:
https://aseetharam.github.io/bioinformatics/run-go-enrichment-maize/

The B73_GO.out data was downloaded from (you need to use the command line):
https://download.maizegdb.org/GeneFunction_and_Expression/Pannzer_GO_Terms/B73_GO.out

# 4. Differential Expression Analyses:
## 4.1. PCA

```{r}
pal <- c("#1F66A9", "#E08201", "#8dc5e4ff")


```


```{r}
rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta), drop = FALSE]

dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)
```

```{r}

for (seg in names(DE_results)) {

  meta_seg <- dat_meta[
    as.character(dat_meta$segment) == seg,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[
    ,
    rownames(meta_seg),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  dds_pca <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group + genotype:condition_group
  )

  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds_pca) >= 10) >= 2

  dds_pca <- dds_pca[keep, ]

  vsd <- DESeq2::vst(
    dds_pca,
    blind = TRUE
  )

  pca <- prcomp(
    t(SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd))
  )

  pca_data <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(pca$x),
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    genotype = meta_seg[rownames(pca$x), "genotype"],
    condition_group = meta_seg[rownames(pca$x), "condition_group"]
  )

  percent_var <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

  p <- ggplot(
    pca_data,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      fill = genotype,
      shape = condition_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4, color = "black",
               stroke = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "w" = 21,
      "c" = 23
    )
  ) +
    xlab(
      paste0(
        "PC1 (",
        round(percent_var[1], 1),
        "%)"
      )
    ) +
    ylab(
      paste0(
        "PC2 (",
        round(percent_var[2], 1),
        "%)"
      )
    ) +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(seg, " - PCA")
    ) +
    theme(text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color='black'),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black')) +
    theme_classic()
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("03_local_response_RNAseq/02_plots/PCA_", seg, ".svg"),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    units = "cm")
}
```

## 4.2. Volcano plots

Inspired by: https://www.datanovia.com/learn/bioinformatics/bulk-rna-seq/differential-expression-deseq2

Create DeSeq object
```{r}
res_list <- list()

for (seg in unique(as.character(dat_meta$segment))) {

  meta_seg <- dat_meta[dat_meta$segment == seg, , drop = FALSE]
  counts_seg <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]
  meta_seg <- meta_seg[colnames(counts_seg), , drop = FALSE]

  meta_seg$genotype <- droplevels(factor(meta_seg$genotype))
  meta_seg$condition_group <- droplevels(factor(meta_seg$condition_group))

  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group + genotype:condition_group
  )

  dds <- dds[rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2, ]
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)

  res_list[[seg]] <- lapply(
    setNames(DESeq2::resultsNames(dds), DESeq2::resultsNames(dds)),
    function(coef) {
      if (coef == "Intercept") return(NULL)
      as.data.frame(DESeq2::results(dds, name = coef))
    }
  )

  res_list[[seg]] <- Filter(Negate(is.null), res_list[[seg]])
}
```
  
```{r}

plot_volcano <- function(res, title, filename) {

  vol <- as.data.frame(res)
  vol$symbol <- rownames(vol)

  vol <- vol[!is.na(vol$padj) & !is.na(vol$log2FoldChange), ]

  vol$status <- "Not sig."
  vol$status[vol$padj < 0.05 & vol$log2FoldChange >  1] <- "Up"
  vol$status[vol$padj < 0.05 & vol$log2FoldChange < -1] <- "Down"

  up <- vol[vol$status == "Up", ]
  down <- vol[vol$status == "Down", ]

  top <- rbind(
    head(up[order(up$padj), ], 10),
    head(down[order(down$padj), ], 10)
  )

  p <- ggplot(vol, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), colour = status)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    # geom_text_repel(
    #   data = top,
    #   aes(label = symbol),
    #   size = 3,
    #   max.overlaps = 30,
    #   colour = "grey20",
    #   segment.colour = "grey70"
    # ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      Up = "#EF4444",
      Down = "#3a86d4",
      "Not sig." = "grey80"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
      y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p),
      colour = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  print(table(vol$status))

  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    units = "cm",
    device = "svg"
  )

  return(vol)
}
```

Updated, but very complicated long code from Chat:

```{r}

# Volcano plot function
plot_volcano <- function(res, title, filename, genes = NULL) {

  vol <- as.data.frame(res)
  vol$symbol <- rownames(vol)

  vol <- vol[!is.na(vol$padj) & !is.na(vol$log2FoldChange), ]

  if (!is.null(genes))
    vol <- vol[vol$symbol %in% genes, ]

  if (nrow(vol) == 0) return(NULL)

  vol$status <- "Not sig."
  vol$status[vol$padj < 0.05 & vol$log2FoldChange > 1] <- "Up"
  vol$status[vol$padj < 0.05 & vol$log2FoldChange < -1] <- "Down"

  top <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Up", "Down"), function(s) {
    x <- vol[vol$status == s, ]
    head(x[order(x$padj), ], 10)
  }))

  p <- ggplot(vol, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)))) +
    geom_point(
      data = vol[vol$status == "Not sig.", ],
      colour = "grey85", size = 0.35, alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = vol[vol$status != "Not sig.", ],
      aes(colour = status), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top, aes(label = symbol),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = 30, colour = "grey20"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0(
        "Up: ", sum(vol$status == "Up"),
        "  |  Down: ", sum(vol$status == "Down")
      ),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = "#EF4444", Down = "#3a86d4")) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
      y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave(filename, p, width = 26, height = 10, units = "cm",
         device = "svg")

  p
}


# Store WT wound-response genes for each segment
wt_wound_genes <- list()

# Loop through segments
for (seg in c("S1", "S2", "S3")) {

  meta <- dat_meta[dat_meta$segment == seg, , drop = FALSE]
  counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(meta), drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta[colnames(counts), , drop = FALSE]

  meta$genotype <- factor(meta$genotype, levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci"))
  meta$condition_group <- factor(meta$condition_group, levels = c("c", "w"))

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts)),
    colData = meta,
    design = ~ genotype * condition_group
  )

  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  # Identify model coefficients
  rn <- resultsNames(dds)
  print(rn)

  # 1. Wounded vs control within each genotype
  for (gt in c("kn", "lox", "haci")) {

    if (gt == "kn") {
      res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition_group", "w", "c"))
    } else {
      interaction <- grep(
        paste0("^genotype", gt, "\\.condition_group"),
        rn, value = TRUE
      )
      condition_coef <- grep("^condition_group_", rn, value = TRUE)

      res <- results(dds, contrast = list(c(condition_coef, interaction)))
    }

    plot_volcano(
      res,
      paste(gt, "|", seg, "| Wounded vs control"),
      file.path("GO_plots", paste0(gt, "_", seg, "_w_vs_c.svg"))
    )

    # Define WT wound-response genes using the same thresholds
    if (gt == "kn") {
      wt_wound_genes[[seg]] <- rownames(as.data.frame(res))[
        !is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05 &
          abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1
      ]
    }
  }

  # 2. Mutant vs WT among wounded samples,
  # restricted to WT wound-response genes
  for (gt in c("lox", "haci")) {

    genotype_coef <- grep(
      paste0("^genotype_", gt, "_vs_kn$"), rn, value = TRUE
    )
    interaction <- grep(
      paste0("^genotype", gt, "\\.condition_group"), rn, value = TRUE
    )

    res <- results(dds, contrast = list(c(genotype_coef, interaction)))

    plot_volcano(
      res,
      paste(gt, "wounded vs kn wounded |", seg),
      file.path("GO_plots", paste0(gt, "_vs_kn_wounded_", seg, ".svg")),
      genes = wt_wound_genes[[seg]]
    )
  }
}
```

## 4.3. Heatmap
### 4.3.1 DESeq2 for heatmap

```{r}

# 1. Create DESeq2 object (Replace with your actual data frames)
# countData: matrix of raw gene counts
# colData: dataframe with sample metadata, last condition is the default comparison (so it's treat vs. ctrl)

# make subset:

# dat_subset_ph <- dat_raw_counts[
#   match(dat_ph_goi$Gene_ID_v5, rownames(dat_raw_counts)),
#   ,
#   drop = FALSE
# ]
# 
# dat_subset_ph <- dat_subset_ph[!is.na(dat_subset_ph$kn_c1_S1), , drop = FALSE]

dat_subset_ph <- dat_raw_counts[
  match(dat_goi$Gene_ID, rownames(dat_raw_counts)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dat_subset_ph <- dat_subset_ph[!is.na(dat_subset_ph$kn_c1_S1), , drop = FALSE]

genotypes <- unique(dat_meta$genotype)
segments <- unique(dat_meta$segment)

results_list <- list()
dds_list <- list()

for(g in genotypes){
  for(s in segments){

    keep <- dat_meta$genotype == g &
            dat_meta$segment == s

    dds_sub <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
      countData = dat_subset_ph[, keep],
      colData = dat_meta[keep, ],
      design = ~ condition_group
    )

    dds_sub <- DESeq(dds_sub)

    res <- results(dds_sub,
                   contrast = c("condition_group", "w", "c"))

    results_list[[paste(g, s, sep = "_")]] <- res
    dds_list[[paste(g, s, sep = "_")]] <- dds_sub
  }
}

```

```{r}
# create matrix for heatmap

for (name in c(
  "kn_S1", "kn_S2", "kn_S3",
  "lox_S1", "lox_S2", "lox_S3",
  "haci_S1", "haci_S2", "haci_S3"
)) {

  # DESeq2 results
  res <- as.data.frame(results_list[[name]])

  # VST transform
  vst_data <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(
    dds_list[[name]],
    blind = FALSE
  )

  vst_matrix <- assay(vst_data)

  # scale each gene
  heatmap_matrix <- t(scale(t(vst_matrix)))

  # get treatment labels
  condition <- colData(dds_list[[name]])$condition_group

  # average replicates
  heatmap_avg <- sapply(
    levels(condition),
    function(x) {
      rowMeans(heatmap_matrix[, condition == x, drop = FALSE])
    }
  )

  # reorder rows according to dat_phytohormone_goi order
  row_order <- match(dat_phytohormone_goi$Gene_ID_v5, rownames(heatmap_avg))
  row_order <- row_order[!is.na(row_order)]

  heatmap_avg <- heatmap_avg[row_order, ]

  # replace row names with gene names
  gene_names <- dat_phytohormone_goi$gene_name[
    match(rownames(heatmap_avg), dat_phytohormone_goi$Gene_ID_v5)
  ]

  rownames(heatmap_avg) <- gene_names
  colnames(heatmap_avg) <- c("Control", "MW")


  ## star matrix for this name only
  
  star_matrix <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = nrow(heatmap_avg),
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(
      rownames(heatmap_avg),
      name
    )
  )

  res <- results_list[[name]]

  common <- intersect(rownames(res), rownames(star_matrix))

  padj <- res[common, "padj"]

  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.001], name] <- "***"
  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.01 & padj >= 0.001], name] <- "**"
  star_matrix[common[!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & padj >= 0.01], name] <- "*"


  # make stars match heatmap dimensions
  stars <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = nrow(heatmap_avg),
    ncol = ncol(heatmap_avg),
    dimnames = dimnames(heatmap_avg)
  )

  stars[, "MW"] <- star_matrix[, name]


  ## save heatmap
  
  # pdf(paste0(name, "_hm2.pdf"), width = 5, height = 12)

  pheatmap(
    heatmap_avg,
    display_numbers = stars,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    fontsize_row = 10,
    cellwidth = 10,
    cellheight = 10,
    main = name
  )

  # dev.off()
}
```

## 4.4. Barplots log-fold change

### 4.4.1. Subset of genes

Loop for everything from ChatGPT:

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

# Make sure count matrix follows metadata order
dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta)]

# Factors
dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Function
# ---------------------------------------------------------

make_segment_plot <- function(segment_name,
                              counts,
                              metadata,
                              goi,
                              padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Subset metadata and counts for this segment
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  meta_seg <- metadata %>%
    filter(segment == segment_name)
  
  counts_seg <- counts[, rownames(meta_seg)]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Create DESeq2 object
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group +
              genotype:condition_group
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Filter low-count genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Run DESeq2
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Interaction tests
  #
  # Does the C-vs-W response differ between:
  #   WT vs lox
  #   WT vs haci
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_interaction <- results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  res_haci_interaction <- results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Significant interaction genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_lox <- rownames(res_lox_interaction)[
    !is.na(res_lox_interaction$padj) &
      res_lox_interaction$padj < padj_cutoff
  ]
  
  sig_haci <- rownames(res_haci_interaction)[
    !is.na(res_haci_interaction$padj) &
      res_haci_interaction$padj < padj_cutoff
  ]
  
  
  # Significant in WT-vs-lox OR WT-vs-haci
  sig_genes <- union(
    sig_lox,
    sig_haci
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Restrict to genes of interest
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_genes <- intersect(
    sig_genes,
    goi$Gene_ID
  )
  
  
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Get C vs W effects
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c(
    "condition_group",
    "c",
    "w"
  )
)

res_lox <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)

res_haci <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "condition_group_c_vs_w",
      "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
    )
  )
)


# -------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Convert C vs W → W vs C
# -------------------------------------------------------

res_WT$log2FoldChange <- -res_WT$log2FoldChange
res_lox$log2FoldChange <- -res_lox$log2FoldChange
res_haci$log2FoldChange <- -res_haci$log2FoldChange
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. Create plotting dataframe
  #
  # Keep both log2FC and lfcSE
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "WT",
      log2FC = res_WT[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_WT[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "lox",
      log2FC = res_lox[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_lox[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    ),
    
    data.frame(
      Gene_ID = sig_genes,
      genotype = "haci",
      log2FC = res_haci[sig_genes, "log2FoldChange"],
      lfcSE = res_haci[sig_genes, "lfcSE"]
    )
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------- 
  # 12. Add interaction p-values to plotting data
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    padj_lox_vs_WT = res_lox_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"],
    padj_haci_vs_WT = res_haci_interaction[Gene_ID, "padj"]
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. Create a significance label:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "lox" & padj_lox_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.001  ~ "***",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.01   ~ "**",
      genotype == "haci" & padj_haci_vs_WT < 0.05   ~ "*",
      
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Calculate vjust in data:
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    star_y = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE,
      log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE
    ),
    star_vjust = ifelse(
      log2FC >= 0,
      -0.3,
      1.3
    )
  )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 15. Add gene names
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    left_join(
      goi %>%
        dplyr::select(Gene_ID, gene_name),
      by = "Gene_ID"
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 16. Plot
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = gene_name,
      y = log2FC,
      fill = genotype
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = log2FC - 1.96 * lfcSE,
        ymax = log2FC + 1.96 * lfcSE
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.25
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = significance,
        y = star_y,
        vjust = star_vjust
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    labs(
      title = segment_name,
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2 fold change (C vs W)",
      fill = "Genotype"
    ) +
    
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    )
  
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. Return everything
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  return(
    list(
      dds = dds,
      significant_genes = sig_genes,
      interaction_lox = res_lox_interaction,
      interaction_haci = res_haci_interaction,
      plot_data = plot_data,
      plot = p
    )
  )
}
```

# 5. Functional interpretation

Make lists of genes for GO-Term analyses

```{r}
# library(dplyr)
# library(tibble)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

rownames(dat_meta) <- dat_meta$sample_description

dat_raw_counts <- dat_raw_counts[, rownames(dat_meta), drop = FALSE]

dat_meta$genotype <- factor(
  dat_meta$genotype,
  levels = c("kn", "lox", "haci")
)

dat_meta$condition_group <- factor(
  dat_meta$condition_group,
  levels = c("w", "c")
)

dat_meta$segment <- factor(
  dat_meta$segment,
  levels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Function
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_segment_interaction <- function(
    segment_name,
    counts,
    metadata,
    padj_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  
  # Subset metadata
  meta_seg <- metadata[
    as.character(metadata$segment) == segment_name,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Keep only samples present in counts
  meta_seg <- meta_seg[
    rownames(meta_seg) %in% colnames(counts),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Subset counts
  counts_seg <- counts[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]
  
  # Ensure identical sample order
  counts_seg <- counts_seg[, rownames(meta_seg), drop = FALSE]
  
  # Drop unused factor levels
  meta_seg$genotype <- droplevels(meta_seg$genotype)
  meta_seg$condition_group <- droplevels(meta_seg$condition_group)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 object
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts_seg)),
    colData = meta_seg,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group +
      genotype:condition_group
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Filter low-count genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Run DESeq2
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # lox10 vs WT interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypelox.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # haci vs WT interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_haci <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    name = "genotypehaci.condition_groupc"
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert to data frames
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  res_lox_df <- as.data.frame(res_lox)
  res_lox_df$Gene_ID <- rownames(res_lox_df)
  rownames(res_lox_df) <- NULL
  
  res_lox_df$segment <- segment_name
  res_lox_df$comparison <- "lox10_vs_WT"
  
  res_haci_df <- as.data.frame(res_haci)
  res_haci_df$Gene_ID <- rownames(res_haci_df)
  rownames(res_haci_df) <- NULL
  
  res_haci_df$segment <- segment_name
  res_haci_df$comparison <- "haci_vs_WT"
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Significant genes
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_lox <- res_lox_df[
    !is.na(res_lox_df$padj) &
      res_lox_df$padj < padj_cutoff,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  sig_haci <- res_haci_df[
    !is.na(res_haci_df$padj) &
      res_haci_df$padj < padj_cutoff,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Positive interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  lox10_positive <- sig_lox$Gene_ID[
    sig_lox$log2FoldChange > 0
  ]
  
  haci_positive <- sig_haci$Gene_ID[
    sig_haci$log2FoldChange > 0
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Negative interaction
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  lox10_negative <- sig_lox$Gene_ID[
    sig_lox$log2FoldChange < 0
  ]
  
  haci_negative <- sig_haci$Gene_ID[
    sig_haci$log2FoldChange < 0
  ]
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Either mutant
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  both_mutant <- intersect(
    sig_lox$Gene_ID,
    sig_haci$Gene_ID
  )
  
  both_mutant_positive <- intersect(
    lox10_positive,
    haci_positive
  )
  
  both_mutant_negative <- intersect(
    lox10_negative,
    haci_negative
  )
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Return
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  
  list(
    dds = dds,
    
    lox10_vs_WT = res_lox_df,
    haci_vs_WT = res_haci_df,
    
    significant_lox10_vs_WT = sig_lox,
    significant_haci_vs_WT = sig_haci,
    
    lox10_positive = lox10_positive,
    lox10_negative = lox10_negative,
    
    haci_positive = haci_positive,
    haci_negative = haci_negative,
    
    both_mutant = both_mutant,
    both_mutant_positive = both_mutant_positive,
    both_mutant_negative = both_mutant_negative
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Run all segments
# ---------------------------------------------------------

segments <- unique(as.character(dat_meta$segment))

DE_results <- lapply(
  segments,
  function(seg) {
    
    message("Running segment: ", seg)
    
    run_segment_interaction(
      segment_name = seg,
      counts = dat_raw_counts,
      metadata = dat_meta,
      padj_cutoff = 0.05
    )
  }
)

names(DE_results) <- segments


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Gene vectors for topGO
# ---------------------------------------------------------

topGO_genes <- lapply(
  DE_results,
  function(x) {
    
    list(
      lox10_positive = x$lox10_positive,
      lox10_negative = x$lox10_negative,
      
      haci_positive = x$haci_positive,
      haci_negative = x$haci_negative,
      
      both_mutant = x$both_mutant,
      both_mutant_positive = x$both_mutant_positive,
      both_mutant_negative = x$both_mutant_negative
    )
  }
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Individual vectors
# ---------------------------------------------------------

S1_lox10_positive <- topGO_genes$S1$lox10_positive
S1_lox10_negative <- topGO_genes$S1$lox10_negative
S1_haci_positive <- topGO_genes$S1$haci_positive
S1_haci_negative <- topGO_genes$S1$haci_negative
```

```{r}
# # Function that does it for all:

# }
# 
# myGenesF <- make_topGO_gene_vector(
#   topGO_genes$S2$haci_positive,
#   gene_names
# )



run_topGO <- function(gene_list, ontology, gene2GO_list) {

  topGO_data <- new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = ontology,
    allGenes = gene_list,
    annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
    gene2GO = gene2GO_list
  )

  fishers_result <- runTest(
    topGO_data,
    algorithm = "elim",
    statistic = "fisher"
  )

  # Return all available GO terms
  fishers_table <- GenTable(
    topGO_data,
    Fishers = fishers_result,
    useLevels = TRUE,
    topNodes = length(usedGO(topGO_data))
  )

  fishers_table$Ontology <- ontology

  # Extract actual, unrounded Fisher p-values
  all_scores <- score(fishers_result)

  fishers_table$Fishers <- all_scores[
    match(
      fishers_table$GO.ID,
      names(all_scores)
    )
  ]

  # Calculate FDR across all returned GO terms
  fishers_table$FDR <- p.adjust(
    fishers_table$Fishers,
    method = "BH"
  )

  # Keep only GO terms with significant FDR
  fishers_table <- fishers_table[
    !is.na(fishers_table$FDR) &
      fishers_table$FDR < 0.05,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  return(fishers_table)
}
```

```{r}
# one big loop:

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")

gene_sets <- c(
  "lox10_positive",
  "lox10_negative",
  "haci_positive",
  "haci_negative",
  "both_mutant_positive",
  "both_mutant_negative"
)

ontologies <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTION TO RUN ONE ANALYSIS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_one_GO_analysis <- function(segment, gene_set) {

  message(
    "Running: ",
    segment,
    " | ",
    gene_set
  )


# Genes of interest
selected_genes <- topGO_genes[[segment]][[gene_set]]

# Skip if there are zero selected genes
if (length(selected_genes) == 0) {

  message(
    "Skipping: ", segment, " | ", gene_set,
    " — zero genes"
  )

  return(data.frame(
    GO.ID = character(),
    Term = character(),
    Annotated = character(),
    Significant = character(),
    Expected = character(),
    Fishers = numeric(),
    Ontology = character(),
    FDR = numeric(),
    Segment = character(),
    GeneSet = character()
  ))
}

# Create topGO input vector
myGenesF <- make_topGO_gene_vector(
  selected_genes,
  gene_names
)

# Also skip if the resulting vector does not contain
# both selected and non-selected genes
if (
  length(myGenesF) == 0 ||
  length(unique(as.character(myGenesF))) < 2
) {

  message(
    "Skipping: ", segment, " | ", gene_set,
    " — gene vector has fewer than two classes"
  )

  empty_result <- data.frame(
  GO.ID = character(),
  Term = character(),
  Annotated = character(),
  Significant = character(),
  Expected = character(),
  Fishers = numeric(),
  Ontology = character(),
  FDR = numeric(),
  Segment = character(),
  GeneSet = character()
)

return(empty_result)
}


  # Run BP
  BP <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "BP",
    all_golist
  )

  # Run MF
  MF <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "MF",
    all_golist
  )

  # Run CC
  CC <- run_topGO(
    myGenesF,
    "CC",
    all_golist
  )

  # Combine
  combined <- rbind(BP, MF, CC)

  # Add metadata (even if there are zero significant GO terms)
  combined$Segment <- rep(segment, nrow(combined))
  combined$GeneSet <- rep(gene_set, nrow(combined))

  # Order by raw p-value
  combined <- combined[
    order(combined$Fishers),
  ]

  return(combined)
}
```

as svg:
```{r}
segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")

gene_sets <- c(
  "lox10_positive",
  "lox10_negative",
  "haci_positive",
  "haci_negative",
  "both_mutant_positive",
  "both_mutant_negative"
)

ontologies <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")


# Calculate plotting significance
GO_all <- GO_all %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = as.numeric(as.character(FDR)),
    neg_log10_FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))
  )

# Select the 15 most significant terms per analysis
GO_top <- GO_all %>%
  group_by(Segment, GeneSet, Ontology) %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = FDR,
    n = 15,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Make one plot for each segment and gene set
for (seg in segments) {
  for (gs in gene_sets) {

    plot_data <- GO_top %>%
      filter(
        Segment == seg,
        GeneSet == gs
      )

    # Skip if no significant terms
    if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
      message("No significant terms: ", seg, " | ", gs)
      next
    }

    p <- ggplot(
      plot_data,
      aes(
        x = neg_log10_FDR,
        y = reorder(Term, neg_log10_FDR),
        size = neg_log10_FDR,
        color = neg_log10_FDR
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_size_continuous(
        range = c(2, 8),
        name = "-log10(FDR)"
      ) +
      scale_color_gradient(
        low = "skyblue",
        high = "red",
        name = "-log10(FDR)"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ Ontology,
        scales = "free_y"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(seg, "|", gs),
        subtitle = "Top 15 GO terms per ontology by FDR",
        x = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
        y = "GO term"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x=element_text(),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color='black'),
        title = element_text(size = 12)
      )

    print(p)

    # Save as SVG in the existing folder
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(
        "GO_plots_trash",
        paste0(seg, "_", gs, ".svg")
      ),
      plot = p,
      width = 26,
      height = 10,
      unit = "cm",
      device = "svg"
    )
  }
}
```

Get all genes that are associated with one of the GO-Terms, and differentially expressed in both mutants in at least one segment, and plot those genes for all segments:

```{r}
segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")
genotypes <- c("kn", "lox", "haci")
mutants <- c("lox", "haci")

# Significance thresholds
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 1

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract genes associated with selected GO terms
# --------------------------------------------------

selected_go_terms <- unique(as.character(GO_all$GO.ID))

go_map <- dat_b73_go2

go_genes <- unique(as.character(
  go_map[[1]][go_map$goid %in% selected_go_terms]
))

go_genes <- go_genes[!is.na(go_genes)]


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit genotype x condition interaction models
# --------------------------------------------------

interaction_results <- list()
condition_results <- list()

for (seg in segments) {

  meta <- dat_meta[
    dat_meta$segment == seg &
      dat_meta$condition_group %in% c("w", "c") &
      dat_meta$genotype %in% genotypes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  samples <- intersect(rownames(meta), colnames(dat_raw_counts))
  meta <- meta[samples, , drop = FALSE]

  meta$genotype <- factor(
    as.character(meta$genotype),
    levels = genotypes
  )

  meta$condition_group <- factor(
    as.character(meta$condition_group),
    levels = c("w", "c")
  )

  # Require at least 2 samples in every genotype-condition group
  group_counts <- table(meta$genotype, meta$condition_group)

  if (length(samples) == 0 ||
      any(group_counts < 2)) {
    warning("Skipping ", seg,
            ": need at least 2 samples per genotype in both conditions")
    next
  }

  counts <- dat_raw_counts[, samples, drop = FALSE]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(counts)),
    colData = meta,
    design = ~ genotype + condition_group + genotype:condition_group
  )

  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2, ]

  if (nrow(dds) == 0) next

  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  rn <- resultsNames(dds)
  print(paste("Coefficients for", seg))
  print(rn)

  # Main c-vs-w effect in WT (kn)
  condition_coef <- grep(
    "^condition_group.*c_vs_w$",
    rn,
    value = TRUE
  )

  if (length(condition_coef) != 1) {
    stop("Could not identify the c-vs-w coefficient for ", seg,
         ". Check resultsNames(dds).")
  }

  # WT c-vs-w results
  condition_results[[paste("kn", seg, sep = "_")]] <-
    as.data.frame(results(dds, name = condition_coef))

  # Test whether each mutant's c-vs-w response differs from WT
  for (mut in mutants) {

    interaction_coef <- grep(
      paste0("^genotype", mut, ".*condition_groupc$"),
      rn,
      value = TRUE
    )

    if (length(interaction_coef) != 1) {
      stop(
        "Could not identify the interaction coefficient for ",
        mut, " in ", seg,
        ". Check resultsNames(dds)."
      )
    }

    # Interaction test: difference in c-vs-w response vs WT
    res_int <- as.data.frame(
      results(dds, name = interaction_coef)
    )
    res_int$Gene_ID <- rownames(res_int)

    interaction_results[[paste(mut, seg, sep = "_")]] <- res_int

    # Actual c-vs-w fold change within the mutant:
    # main condition effect + mutant interaction effect
    res_mut <- as.data.frame(
      results(
        dds,
        contrast = list(c(condition_coef, interaction_coef))
      )
    )

    condition_results[[paste(mut, seg, sep = "_")]] <- res_mut
  }
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Find genes with a significant interaction for
#    BOTH mutants in at least one segment each
# --------------------------------------------------

deg_genes <- list()

for (mut in mutants) {

  genes_for_mutant <- character(0)

  for (seg in segments) {

    res <- interaction_results[[paste(mut, seg, sep = "_")]]
    if (is.null(res)) next

    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)

    significant <- !is.na(res$padj) &
      res$padj < padj_cutoff &
      abs(res$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff

    genes_for_mutant <- union(
      genes_for_mutant,
      res$Gene_ID[significant]
    )
  }

  deg_genes[[mut]] <- genes_for_mutant
}

# Must differ from WT for both lox and haci,
# potentially in different segments
shared_interaction_genes <- intersect(
  deg_genes$lox,
  deg_genes$haci
)

# Restrict to genes associated with the selected GO terms
final_genes <- intersect(
  shared_interaction_genes,
  go_genes
)

cat("Genes with significant lox-vs-WT interaction:",
    length(deg_genes$lox), "\n")
cat("Genes with significant haci-vs-WT interaction:",
    length(deg_genes$haci), "\n")
cat("Genes significant for both mutant interactions:",
    length(shared_interaction_genes), "\n")
cat("Final GO-associated genes:", length(final_genes), "\n")

if (length(final_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No genes passed the interaction and GO filters. ",
    "Check gene ID formats, GO mapping, and thresholds."
  )
}


# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Collect actual c-vs-w log2 fold changes for
#    kn, lox, haci in every segment
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_list <- list()

for (seg in segments) {
  for (geno in genotypes) {

    res <- condition_results[[paste(geno, seg, sep = "_")]]

    if (is.null(res)) next

    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)
    res <- res[res$Gene_ID %in% final_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(res) == 0) next

    plot_list[[paste(geno, seg, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      Segment = seg,
      Gene_ID = res$Gene_ID,
      Genotype = geno,
      log2FC = res$log2FoldChange,
      padj = res$padj
    )
  }
}

if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
  stop("No selected genes were available for plotting.")
}

plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_list)

# Stars here show significance of c vs w within each genotype
plot_data$Significance <- ifelse(
  is.na(plot_data$padj), "",
  ifelse(plot_data$padj < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(plot_data$padj < 0.01, "**",
  ifelse(plot_data$padj < 0.05, "*", "")))
)

plot_data$Genotype <- factor(
  plot_data$Genotype,
  levels = genotypes
)

plot_data$Gene_ID <- factor(
  plot_data$Gene_ID,
  levels = final_genes[final_genes %in% plot_data$Gene_ID]
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot all selected genes across all segments
# --------------------------------------------------

p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Gene_ID, y = log2FC, fill = Genotype)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = Significance,
      vjust = ifelse(log2FC >= 0, -0.3, 1.2)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Segment, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    kn = "grey60",
    lox = "#EF4444",
    haci = "#3A86D4"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "c vs w log2 fold changes for GO-associated interaction DEGs",
    subtitle = "Genes show a significant c-vs-w response difference for both mutants vs WT in at least one segment",
    x = "Gene",
    y = expression(log[2]~fold~change~(c~vs~w)),
    fill = "Genotype"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6
    ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path("GO_plots", "c_vs_w_interaction_DEGs_by_segment.svg"),
  plot = p,
  width = 35,
  height = 16,
  units = "cm",
  device = "svg"
)

```

```{r}
names(condition_results)
```

```{r}

# Keep the original data and plot unchanged
# Assumes condition_results and interaction_results are named
# with paste(segment, genotype_or_mutant, sep = "_")

segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")
genotypes <- c("kn", "lox", "haci")
mutants <- c("lox", "haci")

# 1. Assemble genotype-specific c vs w effects and standard errors
plot_data_new <- do.call(rbind, lapply(segments, function(seg) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(genotypes, function(gt) {

    res <- condition_results[[paste(gt, seg, sep = "_")]]

    if (is.null(res)) {
      stop("Missing condition results for: ", seg, " / ", gt,
           ". Check names(condition_results).")
    }

    res <- as.data.frame(res)
    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)

    res <- res[res$Gene_ID %in% final_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      Segment = seg,
      Gene_ID = res$Gene_ID,
      Genotype = gt,
      log2FC_original = res$log2FoldChange,
      lfcSE = res$lfcSE
    )
  }))
}))

# 2. Flip the plotted log2FC and calculate flipped 95% confidence intervals
plot_data_new <- plot_data_new %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = -log2FC_original,
    ymin = -(log2FC_original + 1.96 * lfcSE),
    ymax = -(log2FC_original - 1.96 * lfcSE),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = genotypes),
    Segment = factor(Segment, levels = segments)
  )

# 3. Get mutant-vs-kn interaction significance for each gene and segment
interaction_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(segments, function(seg) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(mutants, function(mut) {

    res <- interaction_results[[paste(mut, seg, sep = "_")]]

    if (is.null(res)) {
      stop("Missing interaction results for: ", seg, " / ", mut,
           ". Check names(interaction_results).")
    }

    res <- as.data.frame(res)
    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)

    res <- res[res$Gene_ID %in% final_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      Segment = seg,
      Gene_ID = res$Gene_ID,
      Genotype = mut,
      interaction_padj = res$padj
    )
  }))
}))

# Convert adjusted p-values to significance stars
interaction_data <- interaction_data %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      is.na(interaction_padj) ~ "",
      interaction_padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      interaction_padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      interaction_padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# 4. Position stars above each mutant's error bar
star_data <- plot_data_new %>%
  filter(Genotype %in% mutants) %>%
  left_join(
    interaction_data,
    by = c("Segment", "Gene_ID", "Genotype")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = coalesce(Significance, ""),
    star_y = ymax + 0.08 * pmax(1, abs(ymax), abs(ymin))
  ) %>%
  filter(Significance != "")

# 5. Plot flipped fold changes, 95% CIs, and mutant-vs-kn stars
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)

p_flipped <- ggplot(
  plot_data_new,
  aes(x = Gene_ID, y = log2FC, color = Genotype, group = Genotype)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    width = 0.2,
    position = dodge
  ) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = star_data,
    aes(x = Gene_ID, y = star_y, label = Significance,
        color = Genotype, group = Genotype),
    position = dodge,
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Segment, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Gene",
    y = "Flipped log2 fold change (w vs c)",
    color = "Genotype",
    title = "Condition response by genotype",
    subtitle = "Error bars: 95% confidence intervals; stars: mutant vs kn interaction tests",
    caption = "* adjusted p < 0.05; ** adjusted p < 0.01; *** adjusted p < 0.001"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_flipped)

# Save as a new file; does not overwrite your previous SVG
ggsave(
  file.path("GO_plots", "c_vs_w_interaction_DEGs_flipped_errorbars.svg"),
  plot = p_flipped,
  width = 35,
  height = 16,
  units = "cm",
  device = "svg"
)
```

```{r}
segments <- c("S1", "S2", "S3")
genotypes <- c("kn", "lox", "haci")
mutants <- c("lox", "haci")

# 1. Collect c vs w effects for each genotype and segment
plot_data_new <- do.call(rbind, lapply(segments, function(seg) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(genotypes, function(gt) {

    res <- as.data.frame(
      condition_results[[paste(gt, seg, sep = "_")]]
    )
    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)
    res <- res[res$Gene_ID %in% final_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      Segment = seg,
      Gene_ID = res$Gene_ID,
      Genotype = gt,
      log2FC_original = res$log2FoldChange,
      lfcSE = res$lfcSE
    )
  }))
}))

# 2. Flip fold changes and calculate flipped 95% confidence intervals
plot_data_new <- plot_data_new %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = -log2FC_original,
    ymin = -(log2FC_original + 1.96 * lfcSE),
    ymax = -(log2FC_original - 1.96 * lfcSE),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = genotypes),
    Segment = factor(Segment, levels = segments)
  )

# 3. Collect mutant-vs-kn interaction adjusted p-values
interaction_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(segments, function(seg) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(mutants, function(mut) {

    result_name <- paste(mut, seg, sep = "_")
    res <- as.data.frame(interaction_results[[result_name]])
    res$Gene_ID <- rownames(res)
    res <- res[res$Gene_ID %in% final_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    data.frame(
      Segment = seg,
      Gene_ID = res$Gene_ID,
      Genotype = mut,
      interaction_padj = res$padj
    )
  }))
}))

interaction_data <- interaction_data %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      is.na(interaction_padj) ~ "",
      interaction_padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      interaction_padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      interaction_padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# 4. Prepare star positions
star_data <- plot_data_new %>%
  filter(Genotype %in% mutants) %>%
  left_join(
    interaction_data,

  ) %>%

# 5. Grouped BARPLOT with error bars and mutant-vs-kn stars

p_flipped <- ggplot(

) +

    fill = "Genotype",

    subtitle = "Bars show flipped c-vs-w log2 fold changes; error bars show approximate 95% CIs",
    caption = "Stars indicate mutant-vs-kn interaction tests: * adj. p < 0.05; ** < 0.01; *** < 0.001"
```
